title: Part 16 : 2019: Ceramic Tiles — Methods of Test, Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 16 Determination of Lead and Cadmium Given Off by Glazed Tiles
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 16) specifies a method for the determination of lead and cadmium given off by the glaze of ceramic tiles.
clause_3_terminology: Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 16 Determination of Lead and Cadmium Given Off by Glazed Tiles

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
